about:
I am a **Cloud & DevOps Engineer** with 3+ years of experience building, automating, and supporting scalable cloud infrastructure and production environments.

My core expertise includes **AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Ansible, Linux, Python, and Bash**. I have hands-on experience designing AWS infrastructure, building CI/CD pipelines, managing containerized workloads, implementing Infrastructure as Code, and creating monitoring and logging solutions.

In my current role, I work with production-grade AWS environments using services such as **EC2, VPC, IAM, RDS, S3, ECS, EKS, CloudWatch, and Application Load Balancers**. I also focus on deployment automation, reliability, security, observability, and DevSecOps practices.

I enjoy solving infrastructure and operational challenges through automation and continuously improving the reliability, scalability, and security of cloud environments.
